description: Crime safety grade and nearby incident counts for one US address or coordinate pair. Returns a letter score (A+ safest through F), a short description of that grade, and — in cities where police publish incident data — counts by crime type within 1000ft for the same period the grade was built from (date_from/date_to; this varies by city and is not a live feed). incidents is null where we do not have incident data; a count of 0 means none were reported in that period. There is no national-average breakdown and no list of individual incidents. Use this for "is this address/neighborhood safe?" questions. Do NOT use it for demographics, income, rent or schools (use get_neighborhood_data) or for registered offenders (use search_offenders) — neither is included here. Pass either address or lat+lng, not both. US locations only; requires a DoorProfit API key and consumes 1 call from that key's quota, except for the free test address "500 Main St, Dallas, TX 75202".

address.description: Full US street address, e.g. "500 Adams St, Tulsa, OK". Provide either address OR lat+lng.

lat.description: Latitude (use together with lng, as an alternative to address).

lng.description: Longitude (use together with lat, as an alternative to address).

name: get_crime_data

crime_score.description: Letter safety grade from A+ (safest) to F.

crime_score_source.description: "incidents" when the grade comes from reported incidents on that block, "block_group" otherwise.

incidents.description: Incident counts within radius_feet for date_from through date_to. Null when this city does not publish incident data.

by_type.description: Counts for the 12 types the grade uses. Every key is present; 0 means none reported.

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD start of the city scoring period.

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD end of the city scoring period.

location.description: The resolved location for the query.

test_mode.description: True when querying the free test address.

title: Get Crime Data & Safety Score
